How to Accelerate Fracture Healing

Starting exercises as soon as possible

  • Exercising enhance callus formation and accelerate healing as long as the fracture is stable , exercises can be started the next day (if surgical fixation is done) or it can be started after a week , 4 weeks or 6weeks depending on the stability and location of the fracture
  • Exercising strengthen muscles around your broken bone and prevent joint stiffness

Healthy Diet

  • Rich with proteins, vitamins and minerals, foods like vegetables, fruits, eggs and meat
  • Avoid tea: binds with calcium, iron and other nutrients and prevent their absorption , 2 hours after food
  • Avoid alcohol consumption and smoking => slows healing
  • Calcium and vitamin D supplements

Don’t take NSAID

  • Ibuprofen
  • Corticosteroids
  • Ppi: decrease calcium absorption
